카드마다 과일 한 종류가 1~5개 그려져 있다. 사람마다 자기 카드를 한: Each card has 1 to 5 of one kind of fruit drawn on it. Each person turns their own cards face up one at a time onto a pile, and for each person only the one card turned face up on top is visible (when a new card is turned face up, that person's previous card is covered). When the numbers of the same fruit on the visible cards are all added up, if the total for any fruit is exactly five, the bell is rung. If there is no such fruit, the bell is not rung.
